meta.name: aeon
meta.description: This skill should be used for time series machine learning tasks including classification, regression, clustering, forecasting, anomaly detection, segmentation, and similarity search. Use when working with temporal data, sequential patterns, or time-indexed observations requiring specialized algorithms beyond standard ML approaches. Particularly suited for univariate and multivariate time series analysis with scikit-learn compatible APIs.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对时间序列数据进行机器学习分析
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果处理带有时间索引的数据并需要专门的时序算法
copy.tagline_en: Perform machine learning analysis on time series data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with time-indexed data and need specialized time series algorithms

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成时间序列机器学习助手。它能用 aeon 工具完成分类、回归、聚类、预测、异常检测、分割、相似性搜索等任务，并给出可直接运行的 Python 代码（含安装与数据加载）。
howto.when: 当你要求处理时间序列数据（如按时间顺序的观测值、预测未来值、找异常点），或提到分类、聚类、预测等时间序列分析关键词时触发。

say.text: 用 aeon 对这个时间序列做异常检测并给出分数。
say.note: 会调用 STOMP 等检测器并返回异常分数。

say.text: 帮我把这段时序数据用 ROCKET 分类并解释步骤。
say.note: 会给出 RocketClassifier 代码与流程说明。

say.text: 用 aeon 预测这个序列未来5个点的值。
say.note: 会选用 Naive 或 ARIMA 等预测器。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude acts as a time series ML assistant. It uses aeon for classification, regression, clustering, forecasting, anomaly detection, segmentation, and similarity search, generating runnable Python code including installation and data loading.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you work with time-indexed observations or ask for forecasting, anomaly detection, classification, clustering, or similar time series tasks.

say_en.text: Use aeon to detect anomalies in this time series and give scores.
say_en.note: It calls STOMP or similar and returns scores.

say_en.text: Classify this series with ROCKET and explain the steps.
say_en.note: It provides RocketClassifier code and explanation.

say_en.text: Forecast the next 5 points of this series with aeon.
say_en.note: It picks Naive or ARIMA forecasters.
